title: hello-rag — grounded answers over an indexed corpus (target: pipeline)

beats.label: Open the starter README
beats.cue: “An agent grounded in a vector store via the Retrieve tool.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — the committed crewhaus.yaml stays untouched.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env for the run beats.

groups.title: Beat 1 · The spec — retrieval is configuration

beats.label: Name it, pick the shape
beats.cue: “target: pipeline” — the component-DAG runtime, the RAG shape.

beats.label: Add the agent block
beats.cue: Retrieve first, answer in 2–3 sentences, cite by [N] — and refuse what the corpus misses.

beats.label: Wire the retriever
beats.cue: A deterministic embedder into an in-memory store, top 4 chunks a question.

beats.label: Pre-allow Retrieve
beats.cue: Grounding shouldn't stop to ask permission — one alwaysAllow rule.

beats.label: Configure the chunker
beats.cue: Fixed 400-character chunks, zero overlap. The chunker is spec, not code.

beats.label: Add the first document
beats.cue: The corpus is inline: document one is the target-shapes list it'll be asked about.

beats.label: Add the section-18 document
beats.cue: Second document: the production safety floor — sandbox, code execution, injection detector.

beats.label: Add the last two documents
beats.cue: Sections 19 and 20 — the graph and managed shapes. Four documents, no ingestion step.

beats.label: Lint the spec
beats.cue: “Parse plus the IR passes the compile path skips — nothing emitted yet.”

beats.label: Lower the spec to IR
beats.cue: Park the IR in scratch — it's longer than a terminal screen, and it reads better in the editor.

verify.note: IR for target pipeline, redirected to scratch (47 lines) — the next beat opens it

beats.label: Read the IR
beats.cue: indexing.documents — all four of them, inline. The compiler sees documents, not a directory.

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check asserts the shape, installs the deps, and boots it: GREEN.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok (4 anchors); install ok; boot gated at the credentials gate

beats.label: Open the emitted agent
beats.cue: The indexing DAG is right there: chunk → embed → store, wired at boot.

beats.label: Try crewhaus run
beats.cue: The README's Run-it line still says this — it's stale. “run supports target cli or browser”; pipeline is compile-only, so the bundle is the runtime.

verify.note: deliberate rejection, exit 1: `crewhaus run` supports cli|browser; other shapes are compile-only. README.md:13 still advertises this command — the cue owns that on camera rather than leaving the viewer to trip on it.

beats.label: Boot the bundle
beats.cue: [needs-key] Indexing runs first, then it drops into the chat loop.

verify.note: indexes the corpus offline, then needs Anthropic credentials for the loop

beats.label: Ask what it was indexed on
beats.cue: [needs-key] Retrieve fires first and the answer comes back cited [N] — read back off the document, stale roadmap line and all. Grounding means the corpus is the source of truth, not the model.
beats.text: Which target harness shapes does CrewHaus Factory support?

verify.note: the target-shapes document still calls eval/res/voice/brow/batch 'planned' — all five ship today, and the agent will repeat the document faithfully. The cue names that rather than passing the answer off as current.

beats.label: Ask a narrower question
beats.cue: [needs-key] defaultK: 4 over a five-chunk corpus — retrieval ranks rather than filters here, and the citation names the chunk the sentence came from.

verify.note: measured: a keyless boot prints `[pipeline] indexed 5 chunks`, and crewhaus.yaml:15 sets defaultK: 4 — so top-K is a ranking, not a selection

groups.title: One more thing · the corpus is the boundary

beats.label: Ask it something outside the corpus
beats.cue: [needs-key] “I can only answer questions about the indexed docs” — the refusal is spec'd.
beats.text: What's the weather in Tokyo right now?

beats.label: Exit
beats.cue: [needs-key] Back to the shell.
